faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati Project Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff positions is 21 August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Staff at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies for Project Staff posts announced by IIT Guwahati in this recruitment drive. These positions are spread across various specialized roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Staff positions?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies by post, ranging from 8th Pass and 12th Pass to Bachelor's and Master's degrees in relevant fields like Life Sciences, Fisheries, and Food Science.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for IIT Guwahati Project Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.answer: The salary for the Project Staff positions at IIT Guwahati ranges from Rs. 8000 to Rs. 60000 per month, depending on the specific post and its responsibilities.

faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Staff positions at IIT Guwahati will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted for the interview.

faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff positions must be submitted through the online mode only. Ensure you complete the application process before the last date.

faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) is located in Guwahati, Assam.
